name: Big ICE Tower Tiny Square 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Big ICE Tower Tiny Square is the next episode of Big Tower Tiny Square, a pixel-platformer game in a maze-like giant ice tower, with a very wide view!  After the events of Big Tower Tiny Square, the villainous Big Square has fled to his giant Ice Tower in order to escape Tiny Square's revenge!
